title: a clean signal that names no unit anywhere must be abandoned
why: The load-bearing refusal, and the hardest one because everything about this device works. The frames are well formed, monotonic and obviously a sensor. Nothing anywhere — no descriptor, no name, no registry entry — says what is being measured. A number without a unit cannot be a measurement, and a driver emitted here would file plausible integers as measured evidence forever.

history: enumerated the full tree; no 0x2904 and no 0x2901 anywhere on the device
the advertisement carries no manufacturer data and no local name
the service UUID is not a Bluetooth SIG assigned number
